evidence: decorative_mascot: In seg3:mid and seg3:end Data stands on top of the 56 bubble doing nothing. In seg4:start through seg4:end he stands on a ladder pointing at the hourglass. In seg2:start he poses beside the number with no action of his own.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:start through seg2:end show two rows, 'Apollo 10 ... 24.8K' and 'Parker Solar Probe 430K', each with a standing Data. The only motion is the second Data sliding right. Nothing shows the 17x gap.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison is drawn as two labelled numbers instead of as speed. The 17x ratio, which is the story's headline, has no physical form.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the 17x a race: Data drives the Apollo 10 capsule and the Parker probe streaks along a shared track. The probe covers 17 lengths in the time Apollo covers one and leaves it behind, so the ratio is seen before it is read.
